text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain is to take part in a regional conference on youth employment in Cairo next week.
- Bahrain has tremendous potential to further develop its aviation and tourism industry, an Indian expert said.
- Three schools are to be set up in Bahraini villages at a cost of 1.1 million dinars.
- Bahrain Commercial Facilities Company is to pay an eight percent dividend to shareholders for 1996.
